acceptance: Each of the three platforms accepts a staging location through a documented run-time route (platform option or `--output`), following the Glue or Athena Spark pattern; `PlatformHookRegistry.parse_options` accepts the option and the adapter constructs with it set (unit tests, no cloud calls).
Their error messages name that route, and the site platform pages document it.
No live cloud run without explicit spend approval.
context: DECISION GATE: this is a behaviour change (new platform options or config mapping); confirm with the owner which route each platform should use before implementing. Evidence: UsabPlatformMsgs report on #3895 (merged d9ac8d7904).
description: Found 2026-10-31 while correcting platform configuration messages (#3895). The cloud_spark external-table path (benchbox/platforms/base/cloud_spark/external_tables.py) needs an S3 or GCS staging directory, but emr-serverless, dataproc and dataproc-serverless register no staging platform option and have no config builder that maps `--output` to a staging root, so a user has no supported way to supply it through `benchbox run`. #3895 made their error messages accurate (they now name only the adapter setting) but left behaviour unchanged. Glue uses `--output s3://...` and Athena Spark the `s3_staging_dir` option; these three have neither.
